folders.description: Folder paths or special-use flags (e.g., \Inbox, \Sent, \All) to export from

x-meta.usage: Name folders when you want a subset, by path or by special-use flag such as `\Sent`. Leaving it empty is not "nothing", it is a documented default: Gmail and Outlook API accounts export All Mail, and every other account exports every folder except Junk and Trash.
